# Shipwright Studio

> Shipwright Studio is an independent engineering studio crafting websites, web apps, and AI infrastructure for startups and small teams. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, working worldwide. Founded and run by a senior software engineer.

## Services

- **Custom website development**: Fast, accessible, search-friendly marketing sites and landing pages. Modern stack, no bloated templates.
- **Web application development**: Interactive dashboards, internal tools, and customer-facing apps — designed, engineered, and deployed end to end.
- **AI infrastructure**: LLM application engineering, inference cost optimization, GPU communication and distributed training performance.

## Selected work

- **Lumen** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lumen/): An interactive photography lab that teaches the exposure triangle (aperture, shutter speed, ISO) with real-time canvas simulations of depth of field, motion blur, noise, and light metering.
- **Forge** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/forge/): An LLM inference cost estimator. Enter model size, quantization, GPU type, batch size, and traffic to estimate GPU count, latency, and monthly serving cost.
- **The Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/ideas/): An open bank of 68 web experiments — games, developer tools, browser extension prototypes, and small apps. Two new experiments are designed, built, and shipped every day. Recent additions: **Easing Visualizer** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/easing-visualizer/), a free online easing visualizer — drag cubic-bezier control points, preview the animation, and copy the CSS for your transition, all in the browser, **Token Vesting Visualizer** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/vesting-visualizer/), a free online token vesting visualizer — enter a cliff and linear unlock schedule to see exactly when tokens unlock month by month, all computed locally, **Drum Pad** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/drum-pad/), a free online drum pad — tap nine synthesized drum sounds, switch between three kits, and loop a 16-step beat, all in the browser, **Wallet Address Validator** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/address-validator/), a free online wallet address checker — verify an Ethereum address format and its EIP-55 checksum before sending, all computed locally, **Maze Lab** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/maze-lab/), a free online maze generator and solver — generate a perfect maze and watch A* find the shortest path with visited, frontier and path shown step by step, all in the browser, **HTTP Status Guide** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/http-status/), a free online HTTP status code reference — 36 common codes explained in plain English with causes and fixes, live search and class filters, plus a guess-the-code quiz, **Word Counter** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/word-counter/), a free online word counter — paste text to see words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, reading and speaking time and keyword density, all computed locally, **Gas Fee Dashboard** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/gas-tracker/), a free online gas-price board — slow, standard and fast prices across six chains with a congestion meter and transfer and swap cost estimates in dollars, from clearly labelled demo data, **Funding Rate Arbitrage Calc** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/funding-arbitrage/), a free online cash-and-carry calculator — enter spot and perp prices, notional, funding rate and holding period to see funding per interval, daily and annualised funding, fees, breakeven and net P&L, all computed locally, **Game of Life** (https://shipwright-studio.pages.dev/lab/game-of-life/), a free online Conway's Game of Life — paint cells on a 48×32 grid, run Glider, Pulsar and Gosper Glider Gun presets, with speed, wrap-around and randomise controls, all in the browser
